name: KvCacheUpdateWithRopeBackward
reference:
import torch

def run(grad_key_cache, grad_value_cache, key_states, cos, sin, cache_position):
    grad_key_states = grad_key_cache[:, :, cache_position]
    grad_value_states = grad_value_cache[:, :, cache_position]
    half = key_states.shape[-1] // 2
    grad_cos = (grad_key_states[..., :half] * key_states[..., :half] + grad_key_states[..., half:] * (-key_states[..., half:])).sum(dim=(0, 1, 2))
    grad_sin = (grad_key_states[..., :half] * (-key_states[..., half:]) + grad_key_states[..., half:] * key_states[..., :half]).sum(dim=(0, 1, 2))
    grad_key_cache_input = grad_key_cache.clone()
    grad_value_cache_input = grad_value_cache.clone()
    return (grad_key_states.to(torch.bfloat16), grad_value_states.to(torch.bfloat16),
            grad_cos.to(torch.bfloat16), grad_sin.to(torch.bfloat16),
            grad_key_cache_input.to(torch.bfloat16), grad_value_cache_input.to(torch.bfloat16))
description: Backward pass for KV cache update with RoPE. Computes 6 gradient tensors for key/value states, cos/sin, and cache inputs. All outputs in bfloat16.
